caption: The drawing depicts a single wrought and cast iron gate set within a rectangular architectural frame. The entire composition is rendered in black ink on a tan or light beige background. The gate consists of two main panels: the upper panel features a symmetrical arrangement of curvilinear scrolls and X-shaped elements, while the larger lower panel is characterized by an ornate central motif with stylized, symmetric floral and foliate patterns, surrounded by a border of diamond lattice, and vertical decorative spindles on each side. Above the gate and on the side panels are repeated, evenly spaced, vertically oriented decorative ironwork motifs with a floral and scrollwork design. Two rectangular pilasters with simple linear detailing flank the gate on both sides, extending down to the ground, which is indicated by a rectangular pavement area beneath the gate. Centered below the drawing, in hand-lettered text, are the words "WROUGHT & CAST IRON GATE".
title: Cast Iron Gate
